contract.initializeI18n: initializeI18n({locale?: Locale, bundles?: CatalogBundle[]}) -> i18n; synchronous bundled initialization before React mount
contract.setLocale: setLocale(locale: Locale) -> void; changes the existing instance and notifies consumers synchronously
contract.useLocale: useLocale() -> Locale; external-store subscription; no root key/remount
contract.translate: translate(sourceOrKey: string, params?: MessageParams) -> string; exact app-owned source lookup or qualified key
contract.useTranslate: useTranslate() -> translate; callback identity changes with locale for memo dependencies
contract.registry: locales, supportedLocales, isLocale, resolveLocale; en,de,nl,fr,es,zh-Hans; all LTR
contract.stateAndMetadata: Store message(key, params), UIMessage or joinMessages descriptors in state; renderText resolves them in the current locale. Plain strings remain raw. Supplied metadata markers distinguish built-in labels from user-created names.
contract.errorDetails: errorText keeps supplied messageI18n deferred; errorDiagnostic preserves original message/diagnostic/cause text. LicenseGate shows its localized summary and separate raw Technical details. Never String(...) or concatenate a descriptor; the completion gate rejects these coercions.
contract.backend: UIMessage {id,params?,text} matches presentation.go; backend-ids.json maps native IDs to bundled keys. Known descriptors rerender offline. localeURL applies to new API/SSE requests; SWR keys stay unchanged on locale switches to preserve cached records and unsaved forms.
contract.native: Use PreferencesService.GetPreferences/SetLocale snapshots' resolvedLocale, not locale which may be system; subscribe once to preferences:changed and pass resolvedLocale to setLocale. Native preferences/bootstrap remain parent-owned.
contract.document: Parent updates document.documentElement.lang and dir=ltr, title/description and MUI locale alongside locale changes. No DOM text observer.
contract.formatting: Intl helpers are reexported by i18n.ts. formatTimestampNs/formatDurationNs accept bigint or decimal integer strings, never rounded JS numbers. formatDateTime requires seconds|milliseconds and defaults explicitly to UTC; formatPercent requires ratio|percent; formatBytes uses IEC prefixes.
contract.fontQualification: chineseFontFallback uses installed PingFang SC/Microsoft YaHei/Noto Sans CJK SC/Noto Sans SC. Parent applies the stacks and qualifies Simplified Chinese glyphs offline on macOS, Windows and Linux.
contract.packagingSingleton: Root/pages/i18n subpaths must share the same emitted runtime module; source-alias tests do not prove singleton identity after packing separate entrypoints. Parent qualifies the packed hosts.
contract.iframe: ChartFrame adds initial locale/theme and posts netcap:presentation updates without changing src or the opaque-origin sandbox. Preserve allow-scripts allow-downloads.
